AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanIntro: DAN: While searching for treasures, we discovered a TRAINER!
AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanDefeat: DAN: We couldn't win even though we worked together…
AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostBatt: DAN: We can't find any treasures… I wonder if someone got them already?
AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanNotEnoug: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON. You can't expect to beat us like that.
AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraIntro: KIRA: Oh? We were searching for treasures. But we discovered a TRAINER instead!
AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostBat:
KIRA: Where could the treasures be?
I've already decided what I'm buying when we find the treasures!
AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraNotEnou: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON? We'll have to battle some other time!
AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRegiste: KIRA: Oh, you make me so angry! I'm going to register you for that!
AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchI:
DAN: We've been searching for treasures all this time.
Our POKéMON have grown stronger, too. Let us show you, okay?
AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostRema:
DAN: We can't find any treasures, we lose at POKéMON…
I want to go home… But if I say that, she gets all angry with me…
AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchN: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON. You can't expect to beat us like that.
AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematch:
KIRA: Oh? We meet again!
Just like us, you still haven't given up searching for treasures, have you?
Want to make it so the loser has to give up searching?
AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostRem: KIRA: We're not leaving until we raise our POKéMON some more and we find the treasures here!
AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematch: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON? We'll have to battle some other time!
AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniIntro: I'm not good at swimming, but I am good at battles!
AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniDefeat: Oops. That didn't go very well.
AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniPostBat: Walking around barefoot in this ship is kind of gross.
AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonInt: Strength and compassion… Those are a TRAINER's treasures!
AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonDef: Ah, there is something about you that sparkles.
AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonPos: In a cabin somewhere on board, I saw something sparkle.
